item.title: What if an AI bubble bursts and accelerates AI job losses?
item.description: Research on past recessions suggests downturns can accelerate automation. That raises the specter of a double whammy for workers.

item.title: Can the new federal voucher program help public schools? Democrats are torn
item.description: The new scholarship tax credit program could help public school families pay for some educational services, but advocates worry it could do more harm ...

item.title: DOJ files voting crime charges against 28; TikTok disregarded staff child safety warnings
item.description: As Election Day approaches, the Justice Department has charged 28 individuals in California with voting crimes. Meanwhile, TikTok staff raised child safety concerns that were reportedly ignored.

item.title: TikTok staff flagged child safety issues; court records indicate executives did not act
item.description: The warnings emerged from a collection of previously unreported court records. One staff member said they had been fighting for months to fix the issue with people who did not see the harm.
